handedness.visual_basis: From face-on and down-the-line at address the golfer’s left side is closer to the target (lead side left) indicating a right-handed setup.

temporal_orientation.visual_basis: Hands at address and club behind ball, no visible motion yet.
Club and hands clearly lifted away from the ball (backswing starting) compared with address.
Club near top and motion visible changing from away to toward the ball; beginning of downswing visible.
Frames show follow-through and club well past the impact area after the ball.
